subject: Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
body: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 FY2027 stood at Rs 5,842 crore against Rs 5,210 crore in the preceding quarter and Rs 4,931 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. EBITDA was Rs 798 crore. Profit before tax Rs 712 crore. Profit after tax Rs 531 crore against Rs 468 crore sequentially and Rs 412 crore year on year.

subject: Intimation of acquisition of 60% equity stake in a display module manufacturing entity
body: The Board has approved the acquisition of 60% of the paid-up equity share capital of a display module manufacturer for an aggregate consideration of Rs 1,120 crore, to be funded through internal accruals and debt. The target reported revenue of Rs 2,400 crore in FY2026. Completion is expected within 90 days subject to customary approvals.

subject: Resignation of Chief Financial Officer and appointment of successor
body: Mr. Sunil Phansalkar has tendered his resignation as Chief Financial Officer with effect from close of business on December 31, 2026, after nine years with the Company. The Board has appointed Ms. Anita Raghavan as Chief Financial Officer with effect from January 1, 2027. Ms. Raghavan was previously Finance Director at a listed automotive components manufacturer and has eighteen years of experience across automotive and engineering sectors.

subject: Receipt of Establishment Inspection Report from USFDA for Gagillapur facility
body: The Company has received the Establishment Inspection Report classifying the inspection of its Gagillapur formulations facility as Voluntary Action Indicated. The facility contributes approximately 40% of the Company's US revenue.

subject: Intimation of capacity expansion at Raipur facility
body: The Board has approved a capital expenditure of Rs 650 crore towards setting up an additional 3,00,000 tonnes per annum capacity at the Raipur facility, expected to be commissioned by Q4 FY2028 and funded entirely through internal accruals.

subject: Disclosure of SEBI administrative warning
body: The Company has received an administrative warning from the Securities and Exchange Board of India in respect of certain procedural lapses observed during a routine inspection. The warning carries no monetary penalty and does not impact the Company's operations.

Receipt of order worth Rs 4,200 crore from a Middle East client for a transmission project
body: The Power Transmission and Distribution business has secured an order valued at Rs 4,200 crore for the design, supply and installation of substations. Execution is scheduled over 30 months.

subject: Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Financial Results
Declaration of interim dividend and fixing of record date
body: The Board has declared an interim dividend of Rs 6 per equity share of face value Rs 2 each. The record date is fixed as November 18, 2026.

Intimation under Regulation 30 - clarification on news item
body: With reference to a news article regarding a potential plant closure, the Company clarifies that the report is speculative and the Company has made no such decision.

subject: Disclosure under Regulation 7(2) of SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations
Pledge of equity shares by promoter released
body: The promoter has released a pledge over 28,00,000 equity shares representing 4.4% of the paid-up capital, following repayment of the underlying facility.

subject: Notice of Annual General Meeting
Commencement of commercial production at the new injectables devices line
body: The Company has commenced commercial production at its new injectable drug delivery devices line, taking installed capacity to 60 million units per annum.

subject: Audited Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
body: Consolidated revenue for the quarter was Rs 42,180 crore, against Rs 40,986 crore in the preceding quarter and Rs 38,994 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. Operating profit stood at Rs 8,940 crore. Profit before tax was Rs 9,820 crore and profit after tax Rs 7,340 crore, against Rs 6,921 crore sequentially and Rs 6,506 crore a year ago.
